summary: ACME UNITED CORP filed an 8-K reporting the entry into a new $65 million syndicated credit facility with HSBC Bank USA and City National Bank, replacing a prior facility of the same size set to expire in May 2027. The new loan matures July 15, 2029, bears interest at Term SOFR plus 2.00%-2.75%, and is secured by substantially all assets. The opening draw was $28.5 million. This is a routine refinancing of an existing credit line, not a special situation; it provides general liquidity for growth, acquisitions, and dividends, but no specific transaction is disclosed.
